name: ai-file-explorer
description: AI-powered file explorer: desktop app + CLI, backed by local Ollama models

scripts.build: npm -w @afe/core run build && npm -w @afe/cli run build && npm -w @afe/desktop run build
scripts.lint: npm -w @afe/core run lint && npm -w @afe/cli run lint && npm -w @afe/desktop run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @afe/core run typecheck && npm -w @afe/cli run typecheck && npm -w @afe/desktop run typecheck
